# Full copy of backend/requirements.txt, not a `-r` pointer to it — Railway's Railpack builder
# runs its own auto-generated `pip install -r requirements.txt` (ignoring railway.json's
# buildCommand override) from a working directory that turned out to be backend/, where a
# pointer file like `-r backend/requirements.txt` doesn't resolve. Keeping the actual package
# list here means it installs correctly regardless of which directory that command runs from.
# Keep this in sync with backend/requirements.txt if dependencies change.

fastapi
uvicorn
sqlalchemy
psycopg2-binary
sentry-sdk
pydantic[email]
python-multipart
PyMuPDF
pytesseract
Pillow
numpy
opencv-python
sentence-transformers
chromadb
python-docx
google-generativeai
python-dotenv
weasyprint

fpdf
